name: Calf
overview: The topic of the calf in Scripture reveals a sobering picture of Israel's tendency to turn from God to idolatry, as seen when the people made a molten calf in disobedience to the Lord's commands (Deuteronomy 9:16). King Jeroboam further perpetuated this sin by crafting two golden calves and setting them up in Bethel and Dan, leading the people to worship these images instead of the true God (1 Kings 12:28-30). This act not only introduced idolatrous worship but also led to the establishment of unauthorized priests and feasts, corrupting the worship of Israel (1 Kings 12:31-32). These events underscore the danger of substituting God's revealed presence with man-made images, highlighting the need for faithful, Christ-centered worship.
